description: Phase 10 module and declaration migration maps. Modules map original paths to consolidated/topic paths; null destinations are declaration-free facades whose imports were inlined. Declaration keys are post-consolidation, pre-naming identifiers and values are final identifiers. Prefer exact theorem mappings (which include both owner and basename changes), then longest-prefix namespace mappings. Private namespace mappings keep consolidated private module prefixes unchanged; private theorem keys likewise already reflect module moves.
